# hyperfluid_compute_dock (Data Source)

Look up a Compute Dock by name within an environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_compute_dock" "this" {
  env  = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name = "hpc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id.
- `name` (String) Dock name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) `false` when the cluster is suspended.
- `id` (String) Dock id.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase.
- `rest_endpoint` (String) `slurmrestd` endpoint.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.
- `ssh_endpoint` (String) SSH endpoint of the login node.
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.
- `version` (String) Pinned Slurm image tag, if any.
